what_they_sell.claim: Celonis sells the Celonis Platform, a process‑mining solution that builds a real‑time digital twin of a company’s operations.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: The Celonis Platform brings together process data, business knowledge, and intelligence ... to create a dynamic, real-time digital twin of your operations.

what_they_sell.claim: Its Data Core layer extracts data from any source and can query billions of records instantly.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Data Core lets you extract data from any source and query billions of records at speed, scaling to even the largest enterprise volumes.

what_they_sell.claim: The platform enables AI‑driven process analysis, design, and operation for enterprise AI initiatives.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: More than 1,400 companies around the world use Celonis to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.

who_they_sell_to.claim: Celonis targets large enterprises in supply chain, manufacturing, banking, and IT sectors.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: Make supply chains work. Make manufacturing work. Make banking work. Make IT work.

who_they_sell_to.claim: It serves IT services firms such as Fujitsu.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: Fujitsu uses Celonis to gain full transparency into inventory levels and AI‑enhanced recommendations about when to stock‑up, re‑allocate, and refrain from buying materials.

who_they_sell_to.claim: It also works with financial institutions like Standard Bank.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: Standard Bank uses Celonis Process Intelligence to transform CIB Operations—from optimizing cross-border payments to enabling transparency, AI, and automation.

outreach_hook.claim: Celonis serves over 1,400 enterprise customers worldwide.
outreach_hook.cited_excerpt: More than 1,400 companies around the world use Celonis to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.
